inputs.title: Glass Eye
inputs.logline: In a sun-drenched glass city, a young artisan must craft a vision-lens capable of perceiving the invisible currents of the desert wind.
inputs.world: The city drifts above a sea of ochre sand, structures of blown, iridescent glass clinging to massive, slow-moving buoyancy platforms. Harsh, bleached sunlight refracts through crystalline spires and colossal, dormant steam vents.
inputs.lead: Slender build, early twenties, sharp cheekbones framed by dark, tightly braided hair. He wears a tunic of deep indigo linen cinched with a leather sash. He clutches a delicate, glowing crucible.
inputs.continuity: Thin build, indigo linen, dark braids, glowing crucible
